summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Virtus Zevenbergen Innovative Growth ETF (ZINN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of innovative growth companies. The fund uses a research-intensive, bottom-up stock-selection process ZINN was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by Virtus Investment Partners.

holdings.infoBox: ZINN is an equity ETF with a total of 39 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.80%, Advanced Micro Devices at 7.43%, Tesla at 7.11%, Axon Enterprise at 6.11%, and MercadoLibre at 4.77%.
